MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency.
